title: Shinonome Akito — Two Hearts' Resonant Roar〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: ASTRO FES - Day 1
Ensemble Square - Studio

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Exhale*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I think I've got the hang of it... Now I just gotta refine everything.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Even if it's partially an act, I'll be facing off with Sazanami in our joint performance tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (When I heard him sing during our tour of Ensemble Square...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He had so much power and impact... You'd be swallowed whole if you gave anything less than 100% against him.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'll need more energy if I want to stand a chance...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Is that... Sazanami?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Is he practicing in the other studio?
I didn't know he was still at it so late.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In that case...

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Alright. I think I've got this down.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hello, Sazanami.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Oh, Shinonome. Hello.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Did you stay back to practice too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, I did. And since we're both still here, I thought we could do a run-through together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was just practicing that song too... The part where we face off.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Oh, sounds like a plan. It'll be easier to get in the mood if we're together♪

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Alright then, let's do it! By all means, go first.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks. Okay...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here I go!

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: (I was thinking this during our lesson yesterday, but Shinonome sure is good at singing.)

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: (The emotions he projects come across so clearly that I end up getting worked up too...)

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: I guess it's my turn now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Yup, he really is amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, he's gotten better than before. He has much more momentum now.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And he's not pushing through with that alone. The way he uses his voice and his whole body... He has everything thought out and streamlined.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (On top of that...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I can feel his emotions.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's like he's saying there's more where that came from.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But, if that's how things are gonna go...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Wait a second... Did he just gesture for me to join in?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't realize idols were that competitive.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here I come!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line:
*Exhale*
Going all out singing like that sure takes a lot out of you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It really does. Sorry for taking so much of your time.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Don't worry about it, I had fun too. I got caught up in your energy, and thanks to that, I feel like I sang pretty good...

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: And I don't know what it is, but there's something in the way we sing that feels similar...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Weird, right? Especially since we sing totally different genres.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, it's not that... I was actually thinking the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Maybe we have a similar resolve. Kind of like, no matter what happens, we'll make sure to push through it.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: I think you might be right...

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: I touched on this a little yesterday, but... I used to be someone who didn't have anything.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Didn't have anything...?

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Yes. At the idol school I went to, Reimei Academy... Everyone who wasn't a favored student was treated like dirt.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Until Ohiisan... That is, until Hiyori Tomoe from Eden picked me up, I was just another tool in the shed used to make those students shine in the spotlight.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: But I worked day in, day out to refine my skills... And somehow managed to push through.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: So, you could say I have a hunger for success. Maybe more than the average person.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, I think we are similar. I only got this far because I continued to sing despite shedding blood, sweat and tears along the way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'd say I have a strong drive to improve myself.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Haha. I bet. You were getting better as you sang just now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I could say the same for you, Sazanami. Getting to one-up each other after every round was a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: It was. Pushing yourself to continuously try surpassing your opponent really is effective. In the end, we both reaped the benefits.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: I'm really glad that you're my opponent for this joint performance.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sazanami. While we're still in the zone, would you mind going for another round?

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Not at all. I'm down to keep going♪

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Stop right there! Just how long are you two thinking of practicing for?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sena?

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: If you two keep going, it'll impede your performance tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Don't forget that making sure you're in tip-top shape is also an important part of the job.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Hahaha... Sorry. We got a little carried away. Looks like I still have a long way to go.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: We didn't get all of it out of our system, but I guess let's call it a day, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sounds good. Let's pick up where we left off on stage tomorrow.
